T: A murder mystery weekend, Greek island catering.
D: Detective Benoit Blanc joins a tech billionaire's murder mystery weekend on a private Greek island.
P: Serve the mezze when the guests arrive by boat.
S: Hummus, tzatziki, olives, cherry tomatoes and warm pita
Hummus, tzatziki and taramasalata with olives, cucumber, tomatoes and warm pita, laid out on a big board.
Crisp baked wings tossed in homemade red chilli and garlic sauce

Crisp baked chicken wings tossed in a sticky homemade chilli hot sauce, with celery and a cooling blue cheese dip. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Blitz 6 red chillies with 3 garlic cloves, 80ml vinegar and 2 tbsp honey, simmer 5 minutes and toss through the wings. Serve with celery and 150g blue cheese stirred into 150g sour cream.
Glass onion petals with whipped feta
the giant glass onion at the centre of Miles Bron's island

Red onions roasted until sweet, separated into glossy petals and filled with whipped feta, topped with honey, crushed pistachio and oregano. Heat the oven to 200C. Halve 4 red onions through the root, keep the skins on, brush the cut sides with oil and roast cut side down for 30 minutes until soft. Cool, peel and separate into 20 to 24 petals. Blitz 200g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt, lemon zest and 1 tbsp oil until smooth. Spoon or pipe into each petal, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and scatter with 30g crushed pistachios and dried oregano.
M: Lemon, garlic and oregano lamb skewers grilled and served in pita

Lamb marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, skewered and grilled, in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and onion. Cut 800g lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Serve in 4 warm pitas with 250g Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.
a Greek seaside lunch on Miles Bron's island

Octopus simmered until tender, charred hard on the grill and dressed in lemon, oregano and olive oil, with crispy lemon potatoes, capers and red onion. Simmer 1.2kg cleaned octopus in salted water with a bay leaf for 50 minutes until tender, then cool in the liquid. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 800g halved chat potatoes with oil, the juice of 1 lemon and oregano and roast 40 minutes. Cut the octopus into legs, oil and char on a very hot grill 2 minutes a side. Toss with the potatoes, 1 tbsp capers, sliced red onion, lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.
W: Buttery sponge baked over caramelised pineapple rings and cherries

Buttery vanilla cake baked over brown sugar caramel, pineapple rings and glacé cherries, turned out warm and served with whipped cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar in a 23cm cake tin and lay 8 pineapple rings on top with a glacé cherry in each. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, turn out and serve warm with whipped cream.
K: Ginger kombucha with vodka, mint and lime over ice

Chilled ginger kombucha over ice with lime and mint, with a shot of vodka for anyone who wants it spiked like the guests got. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime. Pour 250ml cold ginger kombucha into each and add 30ml vodka to the glasses of anyone who wants it spiked. Stir once and serve straight away.
